brief.tagline: Growing collaboration, one unnecessary recipient at a time.
brief.opening: Rain beads on the glass as ReplySprout’s leafy little campus takes shape.

zones.name: The Welcome Thread
zones.story: The Welcome Thread opens with a sofa and a fish tank that has no email address.

zones.name: The Open Loop
zones.story: The Open Loop fills with desks, plant pots, and drafts awaiting their many recipients.

zones.name: The Send-Off Stage
zones.story: The Send-Off Stage appears, ready for talks on the delicate art of not replying all.

zones.name: The Thread Nursery
zones.story: The Thread Nursery shelves guides for pruning long conversations.

zones.name: The Carbon Copy
zones.story: The Carbon Copy hums beneath blinking lights and one box nobody remembers ordering.

zones.name: The Bean Line
zones.story: The Bean Line steams to life, with enough stools for a spirited queue.

zones.name: The Snack Loop
zones.story: The Snack Loop stocks the fridge and labels the communal oat biscuits.

zones.name: The Glass Reply
zones.story: The Glass Reply assembles around a whiteboard already covered in tiny arrows.

zones.name: The Quiet Thread
zones.story: The Quiet Thread offers booths for calls that could have been shorter.

cast.name: Fern
cast.line: Let’s keep this agenda focused. I’ve invited the whole campus just in case.

cast.name: Pip
cast.line: I added a tiny delay before sending. It gives the finger time to reconsider.

cast.name: Moss
cast.line: The button is friendlier in green. People trust a green button with their entire address book.

cast.name: Ravi
cast.line: I found the test list. It has everyone on it, including the test list.

cast.name: Juniper
cast.line: One fern latte for the thread that could’ve been a note. Oat milk is on the side.

cast.name: Tess
cast.line: The reply-all service is purring again. The suspicious box insists it’s not involved.

brief.closing: The lights glow warmly; somewhere, a carefully composed email gains twelve recipients.
